column3: Kuroneko Route · Offering to Kuroneko
As the trip ended peacefully, we finally came back to our familiar hometown.
Kyou-chan, you really bought a lot of souvenirs.
Yeah, if I didn't get these, I don't know how I would be treated by my mother.
So then, those souvenirs are for your family?
Yeah. I also bought some for Kuroneko.
You're getting along with Kuroneko-san.
It's not that, just that I gave her some trouble before the trip...
Trouble?
We teamed up during the game tournament and Kuroneko really helped me.
It's a souvenir that she asked for, though I intended to buy it even if she didn't ask.
It's not a very good apology. But, well...
I see... It's because Kuroneko-san is a 【Cute Junior】.
Guh! "Cute..."
It sounds strangely embarrassing when she says it...
Well, she's certainly the kind to catch one's eye.
She does have some surprisingly good traits if you look closely.
Ehehe, Kyou-chan is a good senior who takes care of everything.
Quiet.
An Abe no Seimei-related item, huh....
Ah Kyou-chan, you bought a pentagram.
Because she said she was collecting them.
As expected from Kyou-chan. You really understand Kuroneko-san.
That's not true.
You don't have to be embarrassed～
...I'm not!
But, to be honest- I really don't know that much about Kuroneko.
Was it... right to buy this souvenir?
Well, it's not like I can do anything about it now.
Then, I'll be seeing you, Kyou-chan.
Yeah.
It would be good if Kuroneko-san likes the souvenir.
...Yeah. Well then, see you tomorrow.
Yeah! See you tomorrow.
